title: Binary Tree Right Side View
summary: List the values you would see standing to the right of a binary tree, one per level from top to bottom.

tests.explain: Rightmost per level: 1, then 3, then 6. On level 4 the only node is 7, under 4 on the far left, and nothing on that level is further right.
Level 2 holds only the left child 2, so it is visible from the right.

hints: From the right you see exactly one node per level. Which one?
Run a level-by-level BFS and keep the last node of each level: the one at index size - 1.
DFS alternative: visit right before left and pass the depth down. The first node you reach at each new depth is the visible one.

complexity.time: O(n): every node is visited once
complexity.space: O(w) for the queue (O(h) for the DFS version)
